text: Split a tab into multiple panes, vertically or horizontally, for parallel sessions
quote: Divide a tab up into multiple panes, each one showing a different session. You can slice vertically and horizontally

text: Global hotkey brings iTerm2 to the foreground from any app (dropdown-style access)
quote: Register a hotkey that brings iTerm2 to the foreground when you're in another application. A terminal is always a keypress away.

text: Built-in find-on-page with regex support for scrollback search
quote: iTerm2 comes with a robust find-on-page feature. The UI stays out of the way. All matches are immediately highlighted. Even regular expression support is offered!

text: Autocomplete popup (Cmd-;) suggests previously typed words in the window
quote: Just type the start of any word that has ever appeared in your window and then Cmd-; will pop open a window with suggestions.

text: Keyboard-driven text selection and modification (Copy Mode)
quote: Use the keyboard to make and modify selections.

text: Paste history lets you revisit and optionally persist recently copied/pasted text
quote: Paste history lets you revisit recently copied or pasted text. You can even opt to have the history saved to disk so it will never be lost.

text: Instant replay lets you scroll back in time to recover erased terminal text
quote: Instant replay lets you travel back in time to recover text that was erased from the terminal.

text: Shell integration tracks command history, working directory, and hostname, even over SSH
quote: iTerm2 may be integrated with the unix shell so that it can keep track of your command history, current working directory, host name, and more--even over ssh.

text: Jump between previous shell prompts with keyboard shortcuts
quote: you can easily navigate to previous shell prompts with ⇧⌘↑ and ⇧⌘↓

text: Automatically switch profiles based on SSH host, username, or directory
quote: you can have iTerm2 switch profiles depending on what you're doing. For example, you can define a profile that's always used when you ssh to some hostname.

text: Custom escape sequence displays inline images, including animated GIFs, in the terminal
quote: iTerm2 has a custom escape sequence to display images right in the terminal. Even animated GIFs!

text: Native tmux control mode (tmux -CC) integrates tmux sessions as normal iTerm2 windows that persist after disconnect
quote: When you run "tmux -CC", a new tmux session is created. An iTerm2 window opens and it acts like a normal iTerm2 window. The difference is that when iTerm2 quits or the ssh session is lost, tmux keeps running.

text: Official Python package/API to script and extend iTerm2 behavior
quote: iTerm2 offers a Python package which makes it easy to write Python scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior.

text: Sophisticated AppleScript support to launch and control iTerm2, opening sessions/profiles via script
quote: iTerm2 has sophisticated AppleScript support allowing one to write stand-alone scripts to launch the application and open multiple sessions with profiles into either new tabs or new windows.

text: Optional installable component enables generative AI features, kept separate from core app
quote: This is an optional component you can install to enable generative AI features in iTerm2.

text: Browser profiles integrate web browsing into the window/tab/pane hierarchy with terminal features like AI chat
quote: Browser profiles integrate web browsing into iTerm2's window/tab/pane hierarchy. Copy mode, triggers, AI chat, and other terminal features work in browser sessions.

text: User-defined triggers run actions (highlight, notify, run script) when scrollback text matches a regex
quote: Triggers - Regex patterns that fire actions when matched: highlight text, run commands, send notifications, open password manager, set marks, or invoke Python scripts.

text: Smart selection recognizes semantic objects (URLs, paths, emails) via quad-click, with click-to-open
quote: Smart Selection - Quad-click selects semantic objects (URLs, file paths, email addresses, quoted strings). Right-click for context actions. Cmd-click to open.

text: Sessions run in long-lived server processes so shells survive app crashes/upgrades and reconnect on restart
quote: Session Restoration - Sessions run in long-lived server processes. If iTerm2 crashes or upgrades, your shells keep running. When iTerm2 restarts, it reconnects to your sessions exactly where you left off.

text: Open Quickly (Cmd-Shift-O) searches across all sessions by title, command, hostname, directory, or badge
quote: Open Quickly - Cmd-Shift-O opens a search across all sessions by tab title, command, hostname, directory, or badge. Navigate large session collections instantly.

text: When iTerm2 quits or SSH drops, tmux keeps running and windows reopen in the same state on reattach
quote: When iTerm2 quits or the ssh session is lost, tmux keeps running. You can return to the host you were ssh'ed into and run "tmux -CC attach" and the iTerm2 windows will reopen in the same state

text: Built-in LLM chat window can read terminal contents, run commands on your behalf, and explain output
quote: Built-in LLM chat window that can optionally interact with terminal contents. Link sessions to get context-aware help, run commands on your behalf, or explain output with annotations.

text: 24-bit and 256-color mode support for rich, accurate terminal color rendering
quote: With both 24-bit and 256-color mode, Vim explodes with photorealism: the terminal is a medley of color and code comes alive.

text: Shell integration adds click-to-download via SCP, drag-and-drop uploads, per-host command history, frecency-ranked directories, and prompt marks
quote: Enables click-to-download files via SCP, drag-and-drop uploads, command history per host, recent directories by "frecency," and marks at each prompt.

text: Configurable per-session status bar showing git branch, CPU/memory, directory, hostname, or custom components
quote: Configurable Status Bar - Per-session status bar showing git branch, CPU/memory graphs, current directory, hostname, custom interpolated strings, or Python API components.

text: Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast features improve cursor/text visibility automatically
quote: With the Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast features, you can ensure that these problems are gone for good.

text: Taggable, searchable database of connection profiles
quote: iTerm2 provides a taggable and searchable profiles database so you can easily find the profile you're looking for.

text: Global Search lets you search text across all open tabs at once
quote: Search all your tabs at once with Global Search.

text: Mouse reporting feature lets you position cursor and interact with programs like Vim/Emacs via mouse
quote: You can use the mouse to position the cursor, highlight text, and perform other functions in programs like Vim and Emacs with the mouse reporting feature.
